title: Grid to pixels
prompt: A grid has cells 64 pixels wide and tall. Return the pixel position of the top-left corner of the cell at the given column and row.
signature: func solve(column: int, row: int) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(column: int, row: int) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(column, row)
hint: Make a vector from the column and row, then scale it.
solution:
func solve(column: int, row: int) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(column, row) * 64
